title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: R Mason Thomas (personal) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: R Mason Thomas is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Thomas will be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gavin Ortega elevated by Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos elevated OL Gavin Ortega to their active roster for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Ortega will add depth on the offensive line for Denver.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody Schrader elevated by Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos elevated RB Cody Schrader to their active roster for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Schrader will add depth in the backfield for Denver.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jakorian Bennett ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Jakorian Bennett has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: The Eagles secondary will be a little short-handed on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Taylor Rapp signs with Broncos' 53-man roster
items.desc: The Broncos signed Taylor Rapp from their practice squad to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Rapp will add depth in the secondary for Denver.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caelen Carson signs with Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers signed Caelen Carson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Carson will add depth for Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gottlieb Ayedze released by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins released tackle Gottlieb Ayedze from the practice squad.
items.impact: Ayedze will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Campbell signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins guard DJ Campbell to the practice squad.
items.impact: Campbell will add depth on offensive line for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rob Beal Jr. waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived EDGE Rob Beal Jr.
items.impact: Beal will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kevin Givens signed by Colts
items.desc: The Colts signed DT Kevin Givens off the 49ers' practice squad.
items.impact: Givens will add depth on the defensive line for Indianapolis.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Timmy Horne signed by Titans
items.desc: The Titans signed DT Timmy Horne to the team's practice squad.
items.impact: Horne will add depth on the defensive line for Tennessee.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mohamoud Diabate released by Titans
items.desc: The Titans released LB Mohamoud Diabate from their practice squad.
items.impact: Diabate will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (Achilles) off injury report Monday
items.desc: Leonard Williams is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Williams was added to the injury report earlier this week. He'll be good to go in his usual role on Seattle's defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drake Thomas (ankle) off injury report Monday
items.desc: Drake Thomas is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Thomas is set to return in the Seahawks linebacker room.

items.title: Chazz Surratt (calf) off injury report Monday
items.desc: Chazz Surratt is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.

items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) ruled out Monday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Shaheed was unable to practice all week. His absence likely won't impact the Seahawks wide receiver room for fantasy managers.

items.title: Brady Russell (wrist) off injury report Monday
